Stream B — targeted collection (goal A): targets, measured yields, pilots first
Targets are **disjoint primary allocations** of usable train rows after admission and codec (a row is counted once; secondary coverage flags such as "caps" or "numeric" are reported but not summed). Page counts use the measured rows/page where one exists and a 100-page pilot where none does; the pilot sets the quota.

| Category (primary) | Evidence | Usable rows | Rows/page basis | Pages ≈ | Sources (to be qualified in §5) |
|---|---|---:|---|---:|---|
| Polytonic 1850–1890 print | Vouli 4.3%; letter error 2.0% vs 0.6–0.9%; 10 held-out Vouli books; 1850–1935 scope at 76.6% | 40,000 | pilot (historical waves gave 30.9 all-class / 28.6 polytonic train rows per read page, which does not establish the 1850–1890 yield) | pilot → quota | IA 1850–1890 Greek (new discovery; the O4c list holds one Greek IA item), BSB/MDZ, NLG newspapers 1880–1900, Kosmopolis/Pleias, Gennadius (50 pages/week on demand) |
| Polytonic 1900–1982 modern faces | thin in Anemi; scope gap | 50,000 | pilot | pilot → quota | IA university-library scans, Pergamos historical archive, HathiTrust full-view items that permit page access, BSB |
| Modern Greek scanned, non-parliament | 58.3%; one source 62% | 40,000 | Open Archives 18.4/page | 2,200 | Open Archives `ocr_success` docs (44k), Pergamos, Psifiothiki, Lekythos, ELSTAT/Bank of Greece reports, pre-2000 theses |
| Greek with Latin inside | 15.7%; 4.3 mixed rows/page in the mixed wave | 20,000 | pilot (needs ≥10/page to stay under 2,000 pages) | pilot → quota | Persée BCH (1877–), e-rara, E-Periodica/Museum Helveticum, classical commentaries and critical editions, LSJ pages, 1950–1990 scientific journals |
| Latin only | 64.4% | 8,000 | by-product of the row above + Latin editions | 0 extra | same |
| Cyrillic | 29.8%; codec v2 first | 12,000 | 10.5/page under v1; re-measure after v2 | 1,150 (v1 basis) | IA ru/bg/sr 1800–1950; Bulgarian and Serbian national libraries; National Bank of Serbia archive (also numeric tables) |
| Headings / caps | 4.1%; clipped tall headings; display faces | 6,000 | pilot | pilot → quota | page band 0–8% of books not yet read there (**new reads**), newspaper mastheads |
| Numerics / tables | 2.7% | 10,000 | pilot | pilot → quota | ΦΕΚ historic issues, ELSTAT yearbooks (1859–), parliament budget pages, NBS bank reports |
| Leaders / indices | no test stratum | 4,000 | pilot | pilot → quota | tables of contents and indices: page bands 0–8% / 95–100% (**new reads**), plus the 386 R14-pattern rejects as candidates |
| Dialogue / fiction punctuation | Wikisource domain train-absent | 12,000 | pilot (≈ 29–31 rows/page historically for prose waves) | pilot → quota | novels and periodicals (Anemi, IA, Kosmopolis) |

Totals: 202,000 primary rows; pages known ≈ 3,400 (modern non-parliament, Cyrillic) + pilots for every other row; Document AI read cost at USD 1.50 per 1,000 pages ≈ USD 10–20 depending on pilots — **read-cost arithmetic only**; acquisition, rendering (8,494 rendered → 6,279 read last time), failed downloads, storage and review sessions are the real budget and are tracked per wave.
